title: synnema prunelloides
intro: Synnema prunelloides, commonly known as Dwarf Prunella, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the mint family. The health benefits of Synnema prunelloides include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and to treat digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Synnema prunelloides include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
